engine: rung 0: numpy trace reference (+ torch core decay cross-checked in tests); rungs 1-3: executed IF circuits ladder/spiking.py, independently hand-checked by ladder/handcheck.py
no_oracle_statement: Rewards are computed only from spikes the circuit emitted (or from an exogenous random schedule in controls); no expected answer enters weights or spikes. Hand expectations are computed after the run from recorded spikes.

rung_0.outcome_note: Trace-only rung has no synapse or firing behavior by design.
rung_0.same_timestep_order: tag, then reward; zero decay operations at d=0

runaway_and_baseline.note: Reported, not gated. With pure self-reward, r(t)=f_out(t) is perfectly correlated with the post-spike tag it multiplies, so subtracting a running mean removes the average-reward drive but not the spike-contingent drive. Rough estimate (inferred, ignoring post-before-pre pairings and overlapping tags): each output spike nets credit proportional to 1 - rbar*tau_z, which only reaches zero near an output rate of 1/tau_z = 40 Hz.

rung_2.leakage_map_definition: credit breakdown = median(delta_w_B / delta_w_A) >= 0.5 over 5 seeds (B earns at least half of A's credit)

disconnected_but_active_synapse.interpretation: An active synapse with no path to the rewarded output still has eligibility; a global reward changes it about as much as time-shuffled reward does. Eligibility, not wiring, gates credit.
